title: Bandwagon Effect in Marketing
skills: identify bandwagon appeals in marketing and advertising
analyze how popularity and social proof influence audiences
distinguish persuasive popularity cues from credible evidence
evaluate marketing messages for rhetorical techniques and potential manipulation
alignment_note: Examines the bandwagon effect in marketing and how advertisers use popularity, social proof, and group behavior to influence decisions. Supports rhetorical analysis, media literacy, advertising analysis, logical-fallacy recognition, and critical evaluation of persuasive messages across high school English courses.
